name: Erik Karlsson
bio:
Erik's journey into motorsport HR wasn't a straight line. After graduating with a degree in Human Resources, he initially worked for a tech startup in Stockholm. However, a lifelong passion for racing, fueled by watching the Swedish Touring Car Championship as a kid, drew him to Full Time Sports. He started in an administrative role, volunteering at race events, and quickly proved his organizational skills and ability to handle pressure. This led to him transitioning to the HR department.

Erik is known for his meticulous attention to detail and his empathetic approach to employee relations. He believes in fostering a supportive and inclusive environment where every team member can thrive. He is constantly looking for ways to improve the team's well-being and optimize performance through innovative HR practices. His dedication to the team's success is evident in his commitment to finding and nurturing the best talent in the industry.

What sets Erik apart is his ability to blend traditional HR practices with a deep understanding of the unique demands and challenges of the motorsport world. He is not just an HR manager; he is a trusted advisor and a passionate advocate for the people who make Full Time Sports a winning team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a side part
physical.description: Erik is of average height with a lean build and a perpetually focused expression.

quirks: Always has a bag of Swedish licorice within reach.
Insists on conducting team building exercises that involve physical challenges.
Meticulously color-codes all his files and documents.
